# Principia Robotica — C++17 & Python CBF-QP Safety Filter & MCP Gateway

> Unified Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway and real-time Control Barrier Function (CBF-QP) safety engine for autonomous mobile robots and AI agents, implemented in both pure C++17 (`cpp/`) and Python (`principia/`). Achieves median solver latency of 31.5 µs (>20,000 Hz throughput on x86_64) while enforcing continuous-time forward invariance under unicycle kinematic assumptions.

## Core Modules
- `cpp/include/principia/cbf_qp_solver.hpp` & `cpp/src/cbf_qp_solver.cpp`: Zero-allocation C++17 minimum-intervention active-set KKT / Dykstra CBF-QP solver.
- `principia/cbf_engine.py`: Zero-dependency Python CBF-QP & optional CVXPY solver.
- `principia/mcp_server.py`: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP tool server exposing safety filter, Euler-Lagrange dynamics, and DLS inverse kinematics.
- Verification: 68/68 Python tests + C++17 ASan/UBSan test suite (`cpp/tests/test_cbf_qp.cpp`).
